create_ParamId: create a ParamId instance to identify a method parameter by name or index
build_CPInput: build a CPInput dataclass instance specifying split dimension and optional expected dims for context parallel input metadata
build_CPOutput: build a CPOutput dataclass instance specifying gather dimension and optional expected dims for context parallel output metadata
register_TransformerMetadata: register a TransformerMetadata instance with TransformerRegistry for a given model class
get_TransformerMetadata: retrieve TransformerMetadata from TransformerRegistry for a registered model class
